# NOTES — Facts Archive (caveman)

Engineered notes. Facts from repo audit + docs. Written during exploration to
survive compaction. Code refs `path:line`.

## Stack (live)
- Bun 1.3.9, Turborepo, TS ~6.0, React ^19.2, Next ^16.3, `ai` ^7.0.93
  (`streamText`, `Chat`, `ToolLoopAgent`, `toolApproval`, `stopWhen`),
  `@ai-sdk/react` ^4.0.100 (`useChat`, `DefaultChatTransport`),
  `@ai-sdk/groq` ^4.0.37, tRPC v11, drizzle ^0.45, better-auth 1.7.1,
  inngest ^4.20, mem0ai, zustand (0 stores yet), zod ^4.5.
- Supabase local CLI scaffold exists: `packages/db/supabase/config.toml`,
  `.temp/cli-latest`=v2.117.0, `schema_paths=[]`, migrations enabled,
  `seed/seed.sql` referenced but MISSING. Auth enabled (external google
  defaults off). Storage enabled. `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` +
  `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` in `apps/web/.env` but UNUSED.
- Harness: pg (node-postgres) via DATABASE_URL/DIRECT_URL. better-auth tables:
  user/session/account/verification. `src/migrations/` has only `.gitkeep` —
  NO real migrations yet.

## Backend pieces (to be replaced)
- `@aevryn/api` tRPC: `agentRouter` muts = sendMessage, confirmWorkflow,
  discardPlan, updateObjective, runWorkflow, stopWorkflow, toggleSchedule,
  deleteSchedule, markNotificationsRead, resolveApproval, deleteMemories,
  deleteAllMemories, pauseWorkflow, resumeWorkflow. Queries = getThread,
  unreadNotifications, listRuns, listNotifications, listApprovals, listMemories.
- `@aevryn/workflow` WorkflowService god class (1517 lines, ~66 methods), 12
  repos, `schemas.ts` (planSchema `{title,objective,summary,steps}`,
  decisionSchema `{action: complete|sleep|notify|stop|wait,...}`),
  Mem0 store null-degrades w/o key.
- `@aevryn/inngest`: functions execution-run (914 lines, idempotent gate,
  regex-extracts ```json plan/decision), notification-notifier, schedule-tick
  (NO trigger — cron dead), served at `/api/inngest` ONLY executionRun.
- `@aevryn/agent`: 13 capabilities (searchWeb, scrapeUrl, crawlSite, mapSite,
  researchTopic, wireAction, browserSessionList/Create/Rename/Delete,
  createSchedule, storeMemory, searchMemory). Registry + runtime
  `generateText` loop w/ toolApproval gate, replay-by-tool-name, inline
  TOOL_SELECTION_INSTRUCTIONS.
- Env server: DATABASE_URL, BETTER_AUTH_SECRET, BETTER_AUTH_URL,
  ANAKIN_API_KEY/BASE_URL, INNGEST_EVENT_KEY/SIGNING_KEY/APP_ID,
  GROQ_API_KEY, GROQ_MODEL (default `openai/gpt-oss-20b`), MEM0_API_KEY,
  AGENT_MAX_STEPS=5, AGENT_MAX_TOOL_CALLS=50, EXECUTION_MAX_SECONDS=900,
  EXECUTION_MAX_COST_USD=1, EXECUTION_MAX_SLEEP_SECONDS=604800,
  RECOVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS=2, WEBHOOK_BASE_URL. web.ts client empty.

## Anakin SDK 0.1.0 (full surface)
- Client: scrape, map, crawl, search, agenticSearch, wire, countries,
  sessions.{list,create,save,update,delete}.
- ScrapeFormat: markdown|html|cleanedHtml|json|links|images|screenshot|
  screenshotFullPage|summary. Document{...screenshotUrl,fullPageScreenshotUrl}.
- Raw PNG download NOT wrapped — need authed GET /v1/url-scraper/{id}/screenshot.
- Unused today: sessions.save (login→save loop), screenshots, json/links/
  images/summary formats, forceFresh, countries/SUPPORTED_COUNTRY_CODES,
  generateJson, polling knobs.
- REST-only (NOT in SDK): batch scrape ≤10 urls, inline scrape, outputSchema
  on scrape, monitors CRUD, ai-visibility, per-request webhook_url + HMAC
  signature, wire catalog/identities/vaults/wire-run(file downloads),
  CDP Browser API (wss browser-connect: click/type/press/mouse/drag/scroll/
  tabs/waits/evaluate/route/intercept + `?save_session=` `?session_id=`).
- Node-only SDK (no browser build). Adapters call only basic methods.

## UI (packages/ui + apps/web)
- ChatComposer: no props, self-contained. value, files[], queue[], status(idle/
  streaming demo), quality slider 0..50000 (labels Free→God), QueuedStack
  drag-reorder/edit/remove, suggestions[4], openFilePicker, accept default
  image/png,image/jpeg,application/pdf. has onQueueChange/onStop.
- ChatMessage props: `{from:"user"|"assistant", files?:File[],
  thumbnailSize=64, time?, actions?, size?}`. NO `attachment` prop — files only;
  FileThumbnail renders. (User hoped for video/image attachment − need to add).
- SystemMessage: `{icon?,isIconHidden?,cta?:{label,onClick,variant}, cva
  variant: action|error|warning, fill?:bool}`.
- ask-user-questions: AskUserQuestion{id,title,options?,multiSelect?,
  allowOther?,otherPlaceholder?,skippable?,nextLabel?,layout:inline|stacked,
  chipPosition:left|right, freeText?,freeTextPlaceholder?,freeTextMultiline?,
  freeTextValidate?}; AskUserOption{id?,title,description?};
  AskUserAnswer{questionId,selectedIds[],otherText?,skipped?}. NEWTODO:37
  says becomes LLM toolcall schema. QuestionFlow wrapper in packages/ui.
- ThinkingSteps: ThinkingStep{icon(IconName),showIcon,label,description?,
  status:complete|active|pending,delay,isLast}, ThinkingStepDetails{summary,
  details:string[]}, ThinkingStepSources/Source{color,...}, ThinkingStepImage
  {src,alt,caption}. ThinkingIndicator animated morph+words.
- tool-step-calls.tsx: mock ResearchAgent/WebScrapeAgent/CompilingAgent/
  FinalAnswerStep — hardcoded ThinkingSteps.
- workspace/page.tsx (567): ALL hardcoded. Header = SearchableDropdown +
  InputGroup rename (no-op) + Run btn + Settings btn (NEWTODO:253 run visible
  after bound workflow). Conversation = mock ChatMessage/QuestionFlow/
  AccordionGroup(items)/Table/SystemMessage(actions)/ThinkingIndicator.
  Footer ChatComposer empty. NEWTODO:338 mb-40.
- Sidebar (packages/ui/app-sidebar.tsx 419, src-slot empty in web):
  workspace switch (Acme Inc/Personal/New), search (Cmd+K), notifications
  btn (Cmd+N, no chip yet), new btn (Cmd+O), NAV_SECTIONS groups w/ add +
  section dropdown (run all/stop all/rename/delete all), items w/ status dot +
  badge, hover run/stop + rename + 3-dot(share/delete), footer settings/
  theme/user row (Jane Doe mock, Profile no-op). nav-data.ts hardcoded.
- searchable-dropdown: hardcoded WORKFLOW_GROUPS. NEWTODO:16,41.
- workflow-dialog (546): SECTIONS general{name, desc, autoApprove switch, delete},
  share{InputCopy mock}, plan{steps editable}, instructions{system prompt only},
  memories{mock}. NEWTODO wants "Agent" tab + env tab for user keys.
- settings-dialog (491): General/Notifications/Appearance/Security/Members.
- notifications-dialog (119): mock 5 {id,content,read}, no mark-all-read.
- No ProfileDialog (menu no-op). No Toaster mounted. providers = Theme,
  SizeContext, QueryClient(+devtools). authClient dead code.
- Notifications unread-chip missing (user: add like thread button).

## User's new rules
- Auth: Google Supabase ONLY for MVP. Pre-signup questions (who are you: student/
  engineer/AI engineer/...) → profile. Root page.tsx = login screen.
- Workspace "PERSONAL" auto-created per user. MVP single workspace. Schema scalable.
- Sidebar: section search by thread title, notifications chip + mark-read-on-open,
  New btn → new workflow GROUP, group dropdown run all/stop all/rename/delete all,
  workflow item name + status icon + hover run/stop/rename/3-dot.
- Header: dropdown (workflows) + inline rename input. Run/Stop btn only if
  workflow BOUND by toolcall. Workflow settings btn.
- Chat: useChat direct; LLM tools (zod+schema+desc); Anakin tool calls → Inngest
  durable; Inngest returns schematic JSON → ThinkingSteps realtime (sub-tasks too,
  e.g. "reading portfolio/about.html/projects.html"). SystemMessage on error/
  warning/retry; new ChatMessage(assistant) only when error/warning/workflow
  stops/restarts — append same message when running. QuestionFlow parent for
  questionflow, workflowbindingapproval, event approval. Plan editable anyplace.
  LLM decides plan yes/no/steps; user approval UI = workflowApproval questions
  (approve/decline/bind-not-run/request-changes). Decline destroys plan.
  Auto-approve switch → auto Approve + system msg "auto approved via settings".
- Queued messages durable (close window safe). ChatComposer center → bottom after
  first msg; route swap `workspace/<threadId>` no reload. Media: image/pdf upload,
  compress image w/o quality loss → supabase storage. Markdown later (table comp
  ready). Mediums: text, image, speech, transcription, video (per model settings).
- sub-agents parallel later (container collects). mem0 per-thread + global tool.
  zustand for client state; keep server components.
- DB: migrate OLD schema → migration file (snapshot) FIRST, then write NEW schema
  w/ FKs + best practices. No docstrings in code. No hardcoding.
- Deliverables: questions.md, features.md, UI file, PROMPTS file (all prompts in
  one place, export/import), final-docs organizing everything. Env analysis.

# ENV — Variables & User-Suppliable Keys

Three layers: **server/infra env** (Vercel/Next server, never client),
**user workspace keys** (entered by user in Workflow Settings → Agent/Env tab,
stored in DB, encrypted), and **per-thread overrides** (rare, optional).

## Existing env (old backend → what to keep)

| Var | Used by (old) | New use |
|---|---|---|
| `DATABASE_URL` / `DIRECT_URL` | drizzle pg | → Supabase project connection string (keep, used by drizzle) |
| `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET` / `BETTER_AUTH_URL` | better-auth | **DELETE** (Supabase Auth owns sessions) |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` | unused today | keep — supabase-js client |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` | unused today | keep — anon role for RLS/DATA API |
| `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` | — | **ADD** server-only, storage uploads + admin (never NEXT_PUBLIC) |
| `ANAKIN_API_KEY` / `ANAKIN_BASE_URL` | agent adapters | fallback default; user can override per workspace |
| `GROQ_API_KEY` / `GROQ_MODEL` | runtime | fallback defaults; per workspace override |
| `MEM0_API_KEY` | workflow mem0 | fallback; per workspace override |
| `INNGEST_EVENT_KEY` / `SIGNING_KEY` / `APP_ID` | inngest client | keep |
| `WEBHOOK_BASE_URL` | webhook-board | keep |
| `AGENT_MAX_STEPS` / `AGENT_MAX_TOOL_CALLS` / `EXECUTION_MAX_SECONDS` / `EXECUTION_MAX_COST_USD` / `EXECUTION_MAX_SLEEP_SECONDS` / `RECOVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS` | inngest | keep as server caps (hard ceiling) |

## NEW env (definitive list, final)

```
# --- Supabase ---
DATABASE_URL                # postgres connection for drizzle (direct)
DIRECT_URL                  # pooler direct url (non-pooled, for migrations)
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL    # client
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY  # client anon (never secret)
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY   # server only — storage bucket mgmt, user creation
SUPABASE_AUTH_SECRET        # optional: for verifying webhook JWT from auth hooks

# --- Inngest ---
INNGEST_EVENT_KEY
INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY
INNGEST_APP_ID

# --- Webhook interop ---
WEBHOOK_BASE_URL            # base url for generated /api/v1/hooks/:token urls

# --- Defaults (single fallback key each; user overrides per-workspace in UI) ---
ANAKIN_API_KEY
ANAKIN_BASE_URL             # default https://api.anakin.io/v1
GROQ_API_KEY
GROQ_MODEL                  # default text model, e.g. openai/gpt-oss-20b
MEM0_API_KEY

# --- Server hard caps (clamp user values; not editable by user) ---
AGENT_MAX_STEPS             # default 5      — ceiling
AGENT_MAX_TOOL_CALLS        # default 50     — ceiling
EXECUTION_MAX_SECONDS       # default 900    — ceiling
EXECUTION_MAX_COST_USD      # default 1      — ceiling
EXECUTION_MAX_SLEEP_SECONDS # default 604800 — ceiling
RECOVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS       # default 2      — ceiling

# --- Model routing (per category; fall back from workspace → env default) ---
TEXT_MODEL                   # alias of GROQ_MODEL default (kept by name parity)
IMAGE_MODEL                  # default e.g. groq/text2img or provider, optional
SPEECH_MODEL                 # optional
TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL          # optional
VIDEO_MODEL                  # optional (future)
```

> Client (`packages/env/src/web.ts`) must expose only:
> `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`.
> Everything else stays server-only. `SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION` respected.

## Where the USER enters their own keys (UI)

Primary → **Workflow Settings dialog → "Agent" tab** (rename of
"Instructions"), with an **"Environment"** subsection:

- Groq API key + Groq model (text)
- Anakin API key + base URL
- Mem0 API key
- (secondary) Image / Speech / Transcription / Video model overrides

Stored in DB table `workspace_api_keys`:
`workspace_id | user_id | provider | key_name | key_value(encrypted) | created_at`.

Resolution order at call time: **thread override → workflow/workspace key →
env default**. `workflow_api_keys` optional per-thread override keyed same way.
Encryption: AES-256-GCM with `APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY` env (add to server env) — or
Supabase Vault (`vault.create_secret`) if service_role available. Recommend
**Supabase Vault** — no extra env key, native audit.

## Best placement reasoning
- Workspace is the right scope: keys belong to a workspace, reusable in the
  `PERSONAL` workspace and future ones. Thread-level is pointless UX (user
  shouldn't re-enter per thread); we allow per-thread override but never require.
- Server retains hard caps so a user cannot self-grant unlimited budgets.
- Never ship keys to client — tools run server-side (Inngest/route), so only
  server reads them.

input.content:
# DB — Migration: Old Schema First, Then Redesign

Per `LLM_INSTRUCTIONS.md`: migrate the CURRENT (old) schema into a real
migration file to snapshot it, THEN write the brand-new schema. This doc is the
old-schema snapshot + the migration roadmap.

## Step 0 — Current state facts
- Drizzle + `pg` (node-postgres), config: `packages/db/drizzle.config.ts`,
  dataload from `apps/web/.env`.
- `packages/db/src/migrations/` contains ONLY `.gitkeep` — no SQL generated yet.
- Supabase local scaffold exists (`packages/db/supabase/config.toml`,
  project_id `db`, db port 54322, migrations enabled, `schema_paths=[]`,
  **`seed.sql` referenced but MISSING**).
- Old auth = better-auth (tables user/session/account/verification) → to be
  REPLACED by Supabase Auth (Google-only for MVP).
- `scripts/reset.ts` truncates 11 domain tables (workflow, workflow_execution,
  workflow_step, tool_execution, agent_state, event, observation,
  recovery_attempt, schedule, notification, approval).

## Step 1 — Snapshot the OLD schema (the migration ask)

Generate the migration that captures the CURRENT tables, so the redesign result
is compared against it. Use drizzle-kit to produce an initial migration file.

Existing 14 tables (from `src/schema/`, id prefix in `src/ids.ts`):

1. `user` (better-auth) — id, name, email, emailVerified, image, createdAt, updatedAt
2. `session` (better-auth) — id, userId→user(CASCADE), token?, expiresAt, createdAt, updatedAt
3. `account` (better-auth) — id, userId→user(CASCADE), accountId, providerId, **accessToken, refreshToken** (plaintext), expiresAt, password, createdAt, updatedAt
4. `verification` (better-auth) — id, identifier, value, expiresAt, createdAt
5. `workflow` — id(wf_), userId→user, objective, status (9 states), schemaVersion, archivedAt, createdAt, updatedAt
6. `workflow_execution` — id(exe_), workflowId→workflow, status (8 states), reason, prompt, costUsd, tokenCount
7. `workflow_step` — id(step_), workflowId→workflow, executionId, kind, assistantText, status, order, idempotencyKey
8. `tool_execution` — id(tool_), workflowId, executionId (set null), stepId (set null), order, tool, provider, status, input jsonb, output jsonb, errorCode, durationMs
9. `agent_state` — id(agent_state_), workflowId, phase, status, version (optimistic), data jsonb
10. `approval` — id(ap_), workflowId, executionId (CASCADE), userId, toolName, input, status (pending), reason, decidedAt
11. `event` — id(evt_), workflowId (CASCADE), executionId (set null), type, data jsonb, occurredAt
12. `notification` — id(ntf_), userId, workflowId (set null), type, channel, subject, body, deliveredAt, readAt
13. `observation` — id(obs_), workflowId, type, content jsonb, observedAt
14. `recovery_attempt` — id(rec_), workflowId, executionId, failureClass, failureCode, attempt, strategy, result, detail, completedAt
15. `schedule` — id(sched_), workflowId, cron, intervalSeconds, nextRunAt, lastRunAt, enabled, config
16. `webhook_board` — id(whk_), tokenHash (unique), instruction, status, expiresAt, usedAt

> Better-auth `account.access_token`/`refresh_token` + `password` live in
> plaintext columns — snapshot then DROP with the auth tables.

**Command**: `bun db:generate` (turbo `-F @aevryn/db`) with migrations out dir.
Commit this as `001_old_schema_snapshot.sql` in a `migrations/` folder.

## Step 2 — Unexpected-but-simple wins (kill in snapshot while migrating)
- Delete better-auth 4 tables (auth moves to Supabase Auth).
- Delete `webhook_board` (replaced by in-app webhooks via Supabase Realtime +
  RPC; MVP doesn't need external token hooks).
- Delete `agent_state`, `recovery_attempt`, `event`, `observation` (the new
  schema folds activity into different tables; see SCHEMA.md).

## Step 3 — Supabase-init
- `supabase init` already done (`config.toml`). Set `schema_paths`, add
  `seed.sql` (insert PERSONAL workspace for new users via a trigger instead —
  prefer DB trigger → no seed file needed).
- Auth providers: enable Google (`[auth.external.google] enabled = true`,
  create provider in Supabase dashboard with Google OAuth app).
- Realtime: enable `wal_level=logical` for Postgres → Realtime broadcasts.

## Step 4 — Orders of tables (all `create index ... if not exists`)
See SCHEMA.md for full DDL roadmap. Create order:
1. identity/auth users (`auth.users` exists) → 2. workspaces → 3. profiles →
4. threads (per workspace) → 5. workflows (bound to threads) →
6. chat_messages → 7. runs / runs_activity → 8. plans + plan_steps →
9. memories (thread-scoped, mem0-backed idempotent mirror) →
10. notifications → 11. approval_requests → 12. api_keys → 13. files.

## Guardrails
- Run `supabase db advisors` after migration; fix issues before proceeding
  (supabase skill requirement).
- RLS on EVERY table (`TO authenticated` + owner predicate `using/auth.uid()`).
- Keep `drizzle-kit` as tool, but treat Supabase as source of truth; generate
  drizzle migration only when required for type-check parity.

input.content:
# DB — NEW Schema (Supabase + Drizzle)

Design targets (from plan): thread === workflow (1:1 after bind), chat-first,
PERSONAL auto workspace, MVP single-workspace (scalable), durable chat + queued
messages, binding approvals, plans with steps, activities/tool streaming for
ThinkingSteps, per-workspace API keys, mem0 thread memory, files in Supabase
Storage, realtime notifications.

## Conventions
- Every table: `id text primary key` (ULID via `packages/db/src/ids.ts`,
  prefixes `thd_`, `wf_`, `msg_`, `run_`, `pln_`, `pls_`, `apv_`, `not_`, `key_`,
  `fil_`, `wp_`, `awf_`, `alm_`), `created_at timestamptz not null default
  now()`, `updated_at`.
- All plaintext user data (API keys, secrets) NEVER stored — use Supabase Vault
  or encrypted column (see `workspace_api_keys`).
- RLS on every user table: `to authenticated using ( owner = auth.uid() )`
  (+ `with check` on update). Owner column is almost always `user_id`.
- text enums via Postgres `enum` types; drizzle maps to TS unions.

## Tables

### 1. `workspaces`
| col | type | notes |
|---|---|---|
| id | text pk | `wp_` prefix |
| name | text not null | e.g. "Personal" |
| created_by | uuid not null ref auth.users | |
| is_default | bool not null default false | PERSONAL per-user |
| created_at / updated_at | | |
Index: `(created_by, name)` unique.
RLS: owner only.
> MVP: only the auto-created "Personal" per user; schema supports many.

### 2. `workspace_members`
| col | type |
|---|---|
| id | text pk `awf_` |
| workspace_id | text ref workspaces on delete cascade |
| user_id | uuid ref auth.users |
| role | enum(owner, admin, member) default member |
| created_at |
Unique (workspace_id, user_id). RLS: owner + member read.

### 3. `user_profiles`
| col | type | notes |
|---|---|---|
| id | text pk `prf_` |
| user_id | uuid ref auth.users unique |
| onboarded | bool default false |
| pre_answers | jsonb | the signup question answers (role, use-cases…) |
| plan | enum(free, pro) default free |
| created_at / updated_at |
RLS: `auth.uid()`. Written at signup, editable in Profile dialog.

### 4. `threads`  ← chat container AND (bound) workflow
| col | type | notes |
|---|---|---|
| id | text pk `thd_` |
| workspace_id | text ref workspaces cascade |
| user_id | uuid ref auth.users |
| title | text not null default 'New thread' | rename in header input; search target |
| bound_workflow_id | text ref workflows null | set by LLM `finalizeAndInject` tool |
| created_at / updated_at / last_message_at |
Indexes: (user_id, workspace_id, last_message_at desc); trigram or lower(title)
for search.
RLS: owner.
> Thread identifies chat AND workflow (1:1). Must have at least null wf until bound.

### 5. `workflows`
| col | type | notes |
|---|---|---|
| id | text pk `wf_` |
| thread_id | text ref threads null | bind target (nullable pre-bind) |
| workspace_id | text ref workspaces cascade |
| user_id | uuid |
| title | text not null |
| description | text |
| status | enum(waiting, planning, running, awaiting_approval, idle, paused, failed, completed) |
| auto_approve | bool default false | settings switch |
| schema_version | int default 1 |
| created_at / updated_at |
Indexes: (user_id, status), (thread_id).
RLS: owner.

### 6. `plans` + `plan_steps`
`plans`: id `pln_`, workflow_id (unique), title, objective, summary, status
enum(draft, proposed, accepted, declined), created_at, updated_at.
`plan_steps`: id `pls_`, plan_id ref cascade, position int, title, description,
status enum(pending, active, completed, skipped). Unique (plan_id, position).
RLS: owner. Authoritative plan LLM edits via tool; declined → delete rows.

### 7. `chat_messages`  ← single source of the chat history
| col | type | notes |
|---|---|---|
| id | text pk `msg_` |
| thread_id | text ref threads cascade |
| user_id | uuid |
| role | enum(user, assistant, system, tool) |
| content | jsonb not null | one `Message`-shaped object (AI SDK UIMessage) |
| run_id | text ref runs null | which durable run produced it |
| status | enum(draft, queued, streaming, completed, failed, interrupted) |
| queue_order | int null | for queued durable messages |
| created_at / updated_at |
Indexes: (thread_id, created_at asc), (thread_id, status) partial for queued.
RLS: owner.
> Queue: queued rows persist (durable). ChatComposer re-reads queue from DB on
> mount; order = queue_order. On close + reopen the queue survives.

### 8. `runs`  ← a single durable agent pass (an Inngest execution for a thread)
| col | type | notes |
|---|---|---|
| id | text pk `run_` |
| thread_id | text ref threads cascade |
| workflow_id | text ref workflows |
| user_id | uuid |
| trigger | enum(message, schedule, resume, approval) |
| status | enum(pending, running, sleeping, waiting, awaiting_approval, completed, failed, cancelled) |
| prompt_snapshot | jsonb | the prompt/config sent to Inngest |
| cost_usd | numeric(10,6) |
| token_count | bigint |
| finished_at | |
Indexes: (thread_id, created_at desc), (workflow_id, status).
RLS: owner.

### 9. `run_activities`  ← realtime ThinkingSteps feed (Anakin sub-tasks)
| col | type | notes |
|---|---|---|
| id | text pk `act_` |
| run_id | text ref runs cascade |
| parent_id | text ref run_activities null | sub-task nesting |
| type | enum(tool, thinking, task, subtask, system) |
| status | enum(pending, active, complete, failed) |
| step_label | text | e.g. "ResearchAgent", "WebScrapeAgent" |
| title | text | "Reading about.html" |
| description | text |
| detail | jsonb | {url?, sources[], image src?, icon, …} → ThinkingSteps schema |
| started_at / completed_at |
Indexes: (run_id, created_at asc).
RLS: owner.
> Written by Inngest fns, broadcast over Supabase Realtime channel
> `thread:{id}`; client maps row → ThinkingStep / ThinkingStepSource /
> ThinkingStepImage. Mirrors old `event`/`observation` but shaped for UI.

### 10. `approval_requests`
| col | type |
|---|---|
| id | text pk `apv_` |
| run_id | text ref runs on delete cascade |
| workflow_id | text ref workflows |
| thread_id | text ref threads |
| user_id | uuid |
| tool_name | text | which capability needs approval |
| input | jsonb |
| schema | jsonb | AskUserQuestion[] (bind approval) |
| status | enum(pending, approved, denied) |
| auto_approved | bool default false |
| resolved_at |
RLS: owner. Indexes: (status, created_at), (thread_id).

### 11. `notifications`
| col | type |
|---|---|
| id | text pk `not_` |
| user_id | uuid |
| workspace_id | text ref workspaces cascade |
| thread_id | text ref threads null |
| type | enum(system, workflow, run, security, webhook) |
| title, body | text |
| read_at | timestamptz null |
| created_at |
Indexes: (user_id, read_at, created_at desc).
RLS: owner. Read-all marks via update where read_at is null.

### 12. `workspace_api_keys`
| col | type | notes |
|---|---|---|
| id | text pk `key_` |
| workspace_id | text ref workspaces cascade |
| created_by | uuid |
| provider | enum(groq, anakin, mem0, image, speech, transcription, video) |
| key_encrypted | bytea not null | AES-256-GCM or Supabase Vault: `vault.create_secret` |
| model_name | text null | per-provider model override |
| created_at / updated_at |
Unique (workspace_id, provider). RLS: owner only (view masked via RPC).

### 13. `files`  ← uploads (images/pdf) metadata; bytes in Supabase Storage
| col | type |
|---|---|
| id | text pk `fil_` |
| user_id | uuid |
| thread_id | text ref threads null |
| workspace_id | text ref workspaces cascade |
| bucket | text default 'chat-attachments' |
| path | text not null | storage path `{user}/{thread}/{ulid}.ext` |
| mime_type | text |
| size_bytes | bigint |
| compressed | bool default false |
| created_at |
RLS: owner. Storage bucket policy: authenticate (owner by path prefix `{auth.uid()}/`).

### 14. `notification_webhooks` (optional future) — REMOVED from MVP, note only.
External webhooks folded into `notifications` + Inngest `notification/publish`,
existing `webhook-board`/`waitForWebhook` retired.

## Enums (Postgres)
```
role            : owner|admin|member
plan            : free|pro
workflow_status : waiting|planning|running|awaiting_approval|idle|paused|failed|completed
message_role    : user|assistant|system|tool
message_status  : queued|streaming|completed|failed|interrupted
run_status      : pending|running|sleeping|waiting|awaiting_approval|completed|failed|cancelled
activity_status : pending|active|complete|failed
activity_type   : tool|thinking|task|subtask|system
approval_status : pending|approved|denied
api_provider    : groq|anakin|mem0|image|speech|transcription|video
```

## Supabase specifics
- Migrations via `supabase migration new <name>` (imperative workflow).
- **Realtime**: enable on `chat_messages`, `run_activities`,
  `approval_requests`, `notifications` with private channels + JWT auth.
- **Storage bucket**: `chat-attachments` — create server-side w/ service role;
  dedicated policy `(storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text` for
  CUD. Policy for avatar/object keys too.
- **RLS policy list**:
  - everything retrieveable by owner; no cross-workspace leak even if sharing
    added later (member roles ext via `workspace_members`).
  - `workspace_api_keys`: SELECT only to owner via `security definer` RPC
    `get_workspace_key(workspace_id, provider)` that validates membership and
    decrypts server-side (service role decrypt NOT exposed).
- **Oracle triggers**: `on_auth_user_created` → insert `workspaces(Personal)` +
  `user_profiles` row automatically.

## Why this shape (reasoning)
- `threads` + `workflows` split: a chat exists before any plan/bind; binding
  sets `threads.bound_workflow_id`. MVP single-workspace but multi-thread.
- `runs` separate from workflow status: each durable pass is auditable,
  replayable, cancellable; activity tables hang off `run_id`.
- `run_activities` replaces old `event`/`observation`/`agent_state` — shaped
  directly for the ThinkingSteps/ToolStep UI components and realtime push,
  killing the god-table smell.
- `chat_messages` owns history (requirement: no hardcoded mock); queue solved
  by `status=queued` rows — durable across page close/reload.
- Plain user-supplied keys isolated in ONE table (never in env, never client)
  → the "Agent/Environment" dialog writes here.

# ARCHITECTURE — Full New Backend + Frontend Logic

Replaces the old tRPC + regex-decision + god-class backend. The system becomes:

```
Browser (Next.js client, zustand stores)
   │  useChat (Vercel AI SDK @ai-sdk/react 4.x)
   ▼
/workspace/[threadId]   (client page, no full reload on threadId swap)
   │
   ▼  POST /api/chat (ChatTransport → streamText)
   │
   ├── live (fast) tools: askUserQuestion, showPlan, editPlan, memory tools,
   │                      HTTP request tool, media tools
   │
   └── durable (Anakin/Inngest) tools: delegateAgenticWork (one tool)
              │
              ▼  inngest.send("thread/run")
              ▼  Inngest fn "thread-runner" streams run_activities rows
              ▼  Supabase Realtime → ChatMessage updates live in place
```

## A. Auth (Supabase, Google only, MVP)

- Root `page.tsx` = login screen. `supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({provider:"google"})`.
- `onLinkIdentity`/redirect to `/workspace` after signup.
- Post-signup flow: show pre-questions (role: student/engineer/AI engineer/
  author/designer/other + a few about intent). Answers → `user_profiles.pre_answers`
  (auto created by `on_auth_user_created` trigger along with `PERSONAL` workspace).
- `useSupabaseUser()` hook (zustand + Supabase client). Middleware/proxy
  (`src/proxy.ts` evlog) still runs; tRPC session shim removed — server routes
  read `createServerClient` session from cookies.
- Sessions: Supabase handles refresh (`@supabase/ssr` cookie-based). Server
  side: `createServerClient` with anon/publishable; protected route checks user.

## B. Realtime plumbing

- **Supabase Realtime** on tables: `chat_messages`, `run_activities`,
  `approval_requests`, `notifications` (private channels, JWT-auth user filters).
- Client hooks: `useChatRealtime(threadId)` merges live broadcast rows into the
  chat store / useChat message list. **This is how Inngest-produced activity
  reaches the UI** (durable work streams to an open chat).
- Room id convention `thread:{threadId}` on Realtime channel.

## C. Chat transport & message appending (the "no new message every tool" rule)

Streaming in web via `POST /api/chat` using `ChatTransport` protocol:
- Drive `messages` from DB via `chat_messages`, feed to `streamText`.
- **Live LLM path**: `streamText({model, messages, tools, toolApproval,
  stopWhen: isStepCount(maxSteps), system: composeSystem(workflow, plan, memory)})`
  → `toUIMessageStream` → `createUIMessageStreamResponse`. Returns typed
  `UIMessage` parts; `useChat`/`Chat` client keeps ONE assistant message alive
  and appends tool parts to it.
- **Durable path**: when a tool needs Inngest (Anakin, browser, sleep/schedule),
  the route/handler calls `inngest.send("thread/run", …)` and returns a
  "delegated" tool part with the `run_id`; UI shows ThinkingSteps derived from
  `run_activities` streamed in. When the run completes, the ChatMessage gets a
  final assistant part (result text). No new message bubbles for sub-steps —
  everything appends to the same assistant message.
- **New ChatMessage(assistant) triggers** ONLY: error, warning, workflow stops
  unexpectedly, user stops → user clicks Run again. (Per user rule.)

```tsx
// client pseudocode — the appending contract
const { messages, sendMessage, addToolResult, stop } = useChat({ api: "/api/chat", id: threadId });
// useChat actually uses Chat/DefaultChatTransport — bridge in provider
```

## D. Tool surface (LLM-invocable, zod schemas, NEVER hardcoded)

| Tool | When | Runs |
|---|---|---|
| `askQuestion` | clarifying questions (any time LLM needs) | live — returns `AskUserQuestion[]` JSON → UI renders ask-user-questions (MCQ) |
| `showPlan` | after questions/pre-approval | live — returns `{steps: [...], header}` → AccordionGroup |
| `editPlan` | add/remove/update any step | live — persists `plan_steps` |
| `finalizeAndInject` | user approves → bind thread↔workflow, set status | live + sends thread/run if "run" chosen |
| `bindWorkflow` (or `finalizeAndInject` variant) | approve-but-not-run | live — bind only, workflow idle |
| `storeMemory` / `searchMemory` | global + thread memory (mem0) | live (mem0 is low-latency) |
| `httpRequest` | user-supplied bearer token, arbitrary HTTP | live — raw fetch with `Authorization` from user input (scoped, allowlist) |
| `delegateAgenticWork` | ANY Anakin capability (search/scrape/crawl/map/research/wire/browser + schedule) | durable → Inngest `thread/run`; returns run_id |

- `askQuestion` → `AskUserQuestion` schema (from packages/ui
  `ask-user-questions.tsx:37`) — single zod schema shared server+client.
- Auto-approve switch: toolApproval config + `approval_requests` row status
  auto-"approved" when workflow.auto_approve; system message emitted
  "auto-approved via settings".

## E. Durable execution (Inngest): `thread/run`

- ONE event: `thread/run` (down from pile). `thread-runner` function:
  1. fetch everything from DB (thread, plan, memory summaries, previous runs).
  2. `generateText`/`ToolLoopAgent` with the SAME tool set minus the durable
     re-delegation (no recursion);
  3. persist each step/tool into `runs` + `run_activities` + broadcast.
  4. sleep/resume via `runs.status=sleeping` + schedule-tick (FIXED: add proper
     Inngest `triggers: [{ event:... }]` or `cron`) — and register ALL functions
     in `apps/web/src/app/api/inngest/route.ts` serve list.
  5. notify on completion/failure → `notifications`.
- Idempotency: `runs.status` gate `pending→running` with `select … for update`
  in Postgres; retries honor existing activity instead of re-running.
- Cost caps: check BEFORE each step (realtime), not after the run (fix the
  old post-hoc bug).

## F. Frontend state (zustand)

- Zustand stores (each `[thread]`, `[sidebar]`, `[chatComposer]`, `[ui/theme]`,
  `[auth]`) — keeps server components pure; zustand used max; no useState sprawl.
- `threadId` navigation: Next.js `router.push('/workspace/'+id, { scroll:false })`
  updating only param; page reads `params.threadId` once → store. ChatComposer
  layout: centered when no messages → bottom once first message exists.
- ChatComposer: queue (ordered, editable, removable, durable-backend),
  token-quality slider (bugfix: pointer-events interplay — keep slider local
  state OUTSIDE DropdownMenu to fix focus-grab), file/image/pdf attach →
  compress (canvas, WebP, quality 0.8, max 2000px) → Supabase Storage →
  `files` row + `UIMessage` attachments.

## G. Memory (mem0, per thread + global)

- mem0 per thread: `Mem0MemoryStore` scoped `threadId` (userId already scopes
  globally). `storeMemory`/`searchMemory` tools write thread AND global mem;
  metadata `{scope: "thread"|"global", threadId}`.
- Global = workspace `PERSONAL` level; LLM calls `searchMemory(scope:"global")`.
- `packages/agent/src/adapters/README.md:1` resolution: adapter schemas exposed
  to LLM via GLOBAL memory (per user decision already leaning this way) — one
  tool `listCapabilities` returns schemas; keeps them OO-reflectable.

## H. Packages map (rewrite targets)

| Package | Old | New |
|---|---|---|
| `@aevryn/auth` | better-auth | Supabase client + SSR + google + profile trigger |
| `@aevryn/api` | tRPC router | dropped for chat (chat = `POST /api/chat`); keep minimal health/metadata route if needed |
| `@aevryn/agent` | runtime + registry + regex | `runAgent` live (streamText), durable `thread-runner`, tools from schema library |
| `@aevryn/workflow` | god service 66 methods | split: thread-service, plan-service, run-service, activity-service, notification-service, key-service |
| `@aevryn/inngest` | 3 functions, 1 served | serve ALL fns; `thread-runner` + `schedule-tick` (+ custom triggers); notify |
| `@aevryn/db` | 16 tables legacy | new SCHEMA.md (14 tables) + Supabase migration |
| `@aevryn/env` | server only | server + web split, USER keys via DB Vault (see ENV.md) |
| `@aevryn/ui` | components (keep) | real-data wiring (dropdown, nav, dialogs), ChatMessage attachments, ProfileDialog, Toaster mount |

## I. Flow verification scenarios (must "just work")

1. **"Hi"** → user text only, LLM plain text, NO tool call, NO new workflow.
2. **"plan me a laptop comparison"** → LLM askQuestion (MCQ) → user answers →
   showPlan accordion → workflowApproval (approve/decline/bind/run) → bind →
   `thread/run` → ThinkingSteps stream research/scrape sub-tasks into the SAME
   assistant message → final answer text appended.
3. **"scrape X.com profile" (no plan)** → delegateAgenticWork → durable run →
   run_activities stream → final text in same message.
4. **user closes tab mid-run** → run continues in Inngest; reopening
   workspace reloads `chat_messages` + `run_activities` → renders state.
5. **queued "delete workflow" while run active** → message queued durable;
   once run completes → queued delivered.
6. **auto-approve ON** → approval resolves instantly + system message.

## J. Non-goals / pinned decisions
- Markdown rendering: FUTURE (write API to be parser-friendly — parts, no
  prose-heavy gating).
- Media generation: TEXT latest; IMAGE/SPEECH/TRANSCRIPTION/VIDEO schemas +
  model selection ready, wired when UI exists (ChatMessage `files`/attachment
  extension).
- Sub-agents in parallel: FUTURE phase sym (see FEATURES.md); design tool
  outputs as containers so sub-agent results merge into `run_activities`.

# PROMPTS — Single Prompt Library

ONE file, everything exported, imported elsewhere. No string prompts inline.
Located at `packages/agent/src/prompts.ts` (replaces `runtime.ts` inline consts
and planning inline text). Split by role.

```
packages/agent/src/prompts.ts
  system/       — immutable / global behavior
  agent/        — chat agent persona + tool policy
  planning/     — planning-mode instructions
  durable/      — thread-runner instructions (Inngest)
  memory/       — memory tool guidance
  http/         — http tool policy
  subagents/    — (future) container-agent instructions
```

## 1. `SYSTEM_PERSONA`
Intro to aevryn: name, tone (concise, agentic), bounds (chat-only; never
pretend to act outside tools), markdown allowed.

## 2. `SYSTEM_TOOL_POLICY` (replaces TOOL_SELECTION_INSTRUCTIONS)
- Never call a tool for greetings/hi/basic Q&A — plain text.
- Every Anakin / browser action goes through `delegateAgenticWork` (durable),
  never directly in chat.
- askQuestion used for ANY uncertainty the answer changes cost of next step.
- showPlan AFTER questions; workflowApproval via `finalizeAndInject` only after
  plan accepted.
- plan editability: LLM may call editPlan at any time post-plan.
- Respect auto-approve: if enabled, resolve approval automatically and say
  "auto-approved via settings" as system message.

## 3. `PLANNING_SYSTEM` (works with showPlan/askQuestion flow)
"Given the objective, plan scope: ask clarifying questions first when needed.
When you're ready, build the plan. Each step must be actionable and
factored < 20 lines of description. Order critical steps first."
Output: structured via `showPlan(plan)` tool `{steps:[{title,description}]}`.

## 4. `PLAN_WORKFLOW_APPROVAL` (binding message)
"You presented the final plan. Waiting for workflow binding approval
(approve / decline / bind / approve-and-run). Do NOT begin actions before
approval. If declined, discard plan and ask what changed."

## 5. `DURABLE_RUNNER_SYSTEM` (thread-runner in Inngest)
"You are executing plan step N/total. Only the tools you have may run.
Edit plan only via editPlan. Errors: classify and retry with guidance, don't
silently stop."

## 6. `MEMORY_TOOL_GUIDE`
"storeMemory: natural-language facts user wants remembered, category semantic.
searchMemory: retrieve with query matching intent, scope thread|global."

## 7. `HTTP_TOOL_POLICY`
"httpRequest: ONLY for user-requested integration. Send bearer from the user
token field. Do not follow redirects to unexpected hosts. Timeout & size caps."

## 8. `SUB_AGENT_CONTAINER` (future)
"Result JSON: merged into run_activities with type=container. Return markdown
ar interesting findings."

## Usage contract
- `buildSystem(workflow, plan, memorySummary)` composes 1..N prompts with glue.
- Provider-level vs user-level: nothing user-facing; keys/model come from
  workspace_api_keys via key-service BEFORE streamText.
- Single source of truth: importing pkg `prompts` anywhere = consistent.

## Out-of-scope prompts
- Retry guidance / recovery hints: move to `prompts.ts` DURABLE section (was
  inlined in execution-run.ts): keep same codes (RECOVERY_HINTS) but centralized.

# FEATURES — Beyond the MVP (better capabilities & tools)

Ideas to make the tool stronger. Keep "LLM decides, nothing hardcoded".

## Tool-call improvements

### 1. `httpRequest` (user-bearer arbitrary HTTP)
- Schema: `{method, url, headers?{name,value}[], body?, timeoutMs≤30000,
  auth?:{type:"bearer", token}}`, response `{status, headers, bodyText, bodyJson?}`.
- Safety: SSRF firewall (block private IPs/localhost/metadata), size cap,
  max redirects 3, no follow to non-http. Used when SDK lacks an action.

### 2. Anakin SDK expansion (currently underused — see NOTES/Anakin)
- `sessions.save` → interactive-login flow (createSession → noVNC → user logs in
  → save → authenticate scrapes). Map to `browserSessionSave` capability
  (approval required).
- Screenshots: add `screenshot`/`screenshotFullPage` to scrape formats;
  pipeline downloads PNG server-side (SDK doesn't) → Supabase Storage →
  image part in chat (ThinkingStepImage supports src).
- `forceFresh`, `countries`/`SUPPORTED_COUNTRY_CODES` validation,
  `generateJson`/`outputSchema`, polling knobs.
- Batch scrape (≤10 URLs), inline scrape, `ai-visibility` (fan to 3 engines),
  monitors CRUD, wire catalog/identities/vaults (`wire-run`), Wire file
  downloads (`GET /wire/jobs/:id/download`) — all REST-only, expose via
  capabilities that call raw HTTP (this is where **httpRequest tool** shines:
  LLM can call official REST endpoints not yet wrapped).

### 3. Tool approval replay (existing → keep) + auto-approve system msg
- Keep `replayedToolOutputs` (don't re-run possibly-succeeded writes).
- Auto-approve: workflow.auto_approve → auto-resolve approval + system message
  "auto-approved via settings".

### 4. `listCapabilities` / schema-as-memory
- Resolve adapters/README.md:1: expose capability schemas via GLOBAL memory
  searched by LLM before delegating; keep a static `capabilityCatalog` tool as
  fallback (cheap, in chat). Nothing hardcoded in prompt.

### 5. Media generation (per user request)
- TEXT now. IMAGE/SPEECH/TRANSCRIPTION/VIDEO tool tools defined but only
  activate when user enters a model for that category in workflow Agent/Env tab
  (per `ENV.md`). `generateMedia({kind:"image",prompt,...})` → response image
  uploaded to Storage → message part. ChatMessage attachment props extended to
  `{ files[], images[], video?, audio? }`.

## Architecture extras

### 6. Sub-agent container (FUTURE, "agent assigns sub agents")
- Noted in instructions. Design: durable runner can spawn parallel
  `run_activities` children; each sub-agent returns `{role, findings}` to a
  container activity; main LLM reads container. No DB change — already
  `run_activities.parent_id`.

### 7. Durable queued messages (durability fix)
- User asked for an answer: implement queue rows in DB (`status='queued'`,
  `queue_order`), re-pulled on page load. Auto-fire when current run finishes
  (realtime event). Even plain text survives close — since chat persists.

### 8. Per-workspace keys + Vault
- `workspace_api_keys` (Vault/AES) so each future workspace can BYO keys.
  Env fallback → workspace → thread.

### 9. Realtime notifications (with unread chip)
- Notifications dialog + number chip on thread button (user: "add number chip").
  Realtime broadcast on insert. Mark-all-read on dialog open.

### 10. Image compression pipeline
- Browser canvas: re-encode to WebP, quality ~0.8, max 2000px, keep EXIF?
  no — strip. Then `files` insert + Storage. Same pipeline reused for model
  screenshots.

### 11. Parser-friendly output contract
- All tool outputs structured (`{type, data}`) for future markdown/table
  renderers. Table component exists — return `table` parts when tabular.

## UX polish ideas (fold into UI.md)
- Queue: token-quality slider bugfix (pointer-events) — decouple slider.
- ChatComposer centered→bottom transition on first message.
- Run/Stop button gated on bound workflow; per-item run/stop in sidebar menu.
- Notifications chip; theme toggle; profile dialog; settings=workspace+global
  split (rename workflow-dialog → workspace settings, global vs workspace tabs).

# UI — Missing Better Components & Placements

Audit of the current `packages/ui` + `apps/web` against the new behavior, plus
concrete improvement list.

## Required NEW components (missing today)

### 1. Login / Onboarding (`apps/web/src/app/page.tsx`)
- Login screen (Google button) → redirect to `/workspace/[threadId]` or
  `/workspace`.
- Onboarding: pre-questions wizard (the 5 QuestionFlow questions from mock —
  role, use-cases, goal). Save → `user_profiles.pre_answers` → go to workspace.
- No signup email — Google only MVP.

### 2. Profile dialog (missing; menu item currently no-op)
- Sidebar-layout dialog (same frame as settings/workflow dialog).
- Contents: avatar+pfp, name/email, pre_answers display, plan badge,
  delete account (danger), sign out.
- NOTE (user): profile settings only — global settings stay in Settings dialog.

### 3. Notifications dialog + unread chip
- `NotificationsDialog` exists but mock. Add: real list from `notifications`,
  unread-count chip on the thread button top-right (like button badge), mark
  all read on open (server realtime latest-insert ordering).

### 4. ChatMessage attachments — video/music/image support
- Current props only accept `files?: File[]`. Extend:
  `files`, `images[]`, `video[]`, `audio[]`, `attachmentData`.
  ImageComponent fallback: if file type image → thumbnail; else FileThumbnail.
  PDF stays File chip. Video/audio → inline players for media tools.

### 5. Workflow-dialog → split tab (rename per user)
- Rename sidebar `Instructions` → **Agent**.
- Add tab **Environment** (inside Agent or General panel): Groq/Anakin/Mem0
  keys + model name inputs (write `workspace_api_keys`).
- Add **Workspace settings** concept in settings dialog: a `Global` sidebar
  group + a `Workspace` group (only "workspace name" + "invite members").
- Delete-workflow confirm: single dialog accepting id or name, showing name +
  item count + text of what's being deleted (WorkflowDelConfirmationDialog
  exists — wire real data).

### 6. Real data in sidebar + dropdown + header
- `nav-data.ts` `NAV_SECTIONS` ← DB: workspace groups (threads/titles/statuses).
- `searchable-dropdown` ← DB workflows. Unify with header input bar (NEWTODO).
- AppSidebar: replace mock "Jane Doe", Acme Inc with real user + workspace.

### 7. Run/Stop button prominence
- Thread page header: Run/Stop swapped by live state, only when workflow BOUND
  (bind by LLM tool) — else hidden (current NEWTODO:253). Same idea in item
  hover + group "run all/stop all".

## Fixes / polish

- **ChatComposer** center → bottom transition after first message; page
  `workspace/<threadId>` swap must NOT reload (`useRouter().push` + param-only
  update); token slider: store `quality` in zustand (UI state) NOT inside
  DropdownMenu so clicks don't steal/grab; drag works (bug user reported).
- Queue: durable orders (DB), reorder/remove/edit via QueuedStack → persist.
- `mb-40` (NEWTODO:338): replace with `SystemMessage`/component spacing rule.
- Mount `<Toaster/>` (sonner) — currently absent → error toasts never show.
- Search: title triggers → DB query index (lower(title) trigram) — debounced.
- "New" button → new workflow GROUP (not thread); + default thread inside.
- Empty Thread: ChatComposer centered; non-empty: bottom-anchored, autoscroll.
- ThinkingSteps: animate from `run_activities` stream; skeletons + dot loaders
  for waiting state; status icons reuse existing dot/filled-vs-unfilled.

## Suggested structure additions (apps/web)
```
src/stores/         zustand: useAuthStore, useThreadStore, useComposerStore,
                              useSidebarStore, useNotificationsStore, useUIStore
src/app/api/chat/route.ts          (streamText Chat transport)
src/app/api/queue/route.ts         (push/drain queued messages)
src/components/onboarding/Questions.tsx
src/components/chat/ToolActivity.tsx     (maps run_activities rows → ThinkingSteps)
src/components/chat/WorkflowApproval.tsx
src/components/profile/ProfileDialog.tsx
src/components/sidebar/  (search, notifications, workflow-group…)
src/hooks/useRealtimeThread.ts      (subscribe)
src/lib/supabase-client.ts / server.ts
```

## Colors/theming
Keep SizeProvider + ThemeProvider; add workspace "tile" color picker for
future multi-workspace (visual only MVP single).

input.content:
# QUESTIONS — Clarifications Needed

Decisions that block exact implementation. Answer in this file or point me to
the place. (No blockers for the docs; these refine behavior.)

## A. Workflow binding semantics
1. "Bind but not run now" — after `bindWorkflow`, what's Run/Stop button state?
   (I assume: workflow status idle, Run visible, Stop hidden → pressing Run
   sends `thread/run`.)
2. If user opens a NEW chat with no plan and sends 2nd msg before plan / binding,
   are we auto-creating a draft thread (existing) or strict "no workflow until
   LLM decides to plan"? (LLM decides.)

## B. Scheduling
3. schedule-tick bug = no Inngest trigger + not served. Do we keep cron INSIDE
   Inngest (`triggers: [{ cron: "..." }]`) or move to Supabase pg_cron (scheduling
   table + row updated by runner)? User mentioned "ask which lib if cron can't
   auto-invoke". I recommend Inngest cron since we already run there; pg_cron
   alternative if we shed Inngest.

## C. Media generation
4. Image/speech/transcription/video: MVP shipped with TEXT only + tool stubs, or
   wire GENERATION now for image + transcription? Need model names for each
   category (user enters) + provider routing. Suggest MVP: implement
   `generateImage` + `transcribeAudio` schemas, lazy-load providers only if
   `IMAGE_MODEL`/`TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL` set.

## D. Auth + onboarding
5. Pre-questions list: role(student/engineer/AI engineer/dev/designer/other),
   use-case(create workflows/automation/research/learning/other), goal, team?
   Need final question set + multi-select vs single.
6. If Google signup already linked to Supabase but profile row missing — auto
   navigate to onboarding? OK to create on-demand.

## E. Queue model
7. Queue semantics when run is RUNNING: queue behind current run, or immediate?
   (Recommend: queue; once runner finishes, deliver in order.)
8. If user edits queued msg content (QueuedStack edit) — persist updated row,
   same order. Confirm.

## F. Memory
9. mem0 = hosted API. Per-thread via `user_id`+`threadId` metadata filtering OK,
   or use separate mem0 user_id per thread? (Recommend: one mem0 user per app
   user, `metadata.threadId` filter; global = metadata.scope global.)
10. Global memory = workspace PERSONAL memory. When multi-workspace later, global
   = per-workspace. OK?

## G. HTTP tool
11. Allowed protocols http/https only? whitelist/blocklist? Suggest https-only +
   block private/IPv6-link-local + user must opt-in per call (bearer).

## H. Misc
12. `finalizeAndInject` naming — keep SDK naming real (`finalizeAndInject`
   from docs example) or rename to `bindWorkflow`? Recommend SDK-compatible name.
13. Delete-account flow: soft delete (profile archived) or hard delete incl.
   Storage files? Recommend Soft (Supabase delete via RPC w/ service role).
14. Pricing/usage page: track per-run cost + token (runs.cost_usd,
   token_count) — needed for dashboard later. Confirm auto-record.
15. Markdown renderer: confirm build now vs defer (recommend defer; output
   contract ready).

<hr>
Also see: [`READ_ME missing.items`] — list anything I flagged as missing from
LLM_INSTRUCTIONS that you should still specify (e.g. exact onboarding question
set, per-workspace member invite details, final model names).

# PLAN — Full Implementation Plan

Milestone-driven, each phase independently verifiable. Build order respects
dependency: DB first, services next, Inngest, then UI, then polish.

## P0 — Groundwork & migrations (prereq for everything)
- [ ] Supabase local running; `supabase init` config sanity (`config.toml`
      `schema_paths`, real migrate workflow). Create `001_old_schema_snapshot`
      via drizzle-kit (see `db/MIGRATION.md`).
- [ ] `supabase/migrations` seed enforcement (drop seed file, use trigger).
- [ ] `scripts/` service helpers updated (no destructive ops in CI).
- [ ] Verify `bun run db:generate` produces snapshot; commit as baseline.
- **Verify**: `supabase migration list --local` shows snapshot applied.

## P1 — Auth (Supabase, Google-only)
- [ ] Env: add `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL/PUBLISHABLE_KEY`, service role server.
- [ ] `packages/auth`: rewrite to Supabase server/client init (replace
      better-auth). `src/lib/supabase-server.ts` + `supabase-client.ts`.
- [ ] Middleware/proxy `src/proxy.ts` auth-aware (session guard).
- [ ] `on_auth_user_created` trigger (SQL): create Personal workspace + profile.
- [ ] Root `page.tsx`: login (Google), post-signup onboarding questions flow.
- **Verify**: Google login → Personal workspace exists → redirect workspace.

## P2 — New DB schema (see db/SCHEMA.md)
- [ ] `supabase migration new new_schema` → all 14 tables + enums + RLS +
      indexes + storage bucket `chat-attachments` + Realtime enabled for
      4 tables (chat_messages, run_activities, approval_requests,
      notifications).
- [ ] Drizzle types parity: regenerate `packages/db/src/schema` from new SQL.
- [ ] Drop legacy tables (auth/session/account/verification, webhook_board,
      agent_state, recovery_attempt, event, observation) in migration.
- [ ] `supabase db advisors` clean.
- **Verify**: advisors pass; RLS smoke test (anon/authenticated) via psql.

## P3 — Services (packages/workflow split; drop tRPC god router)
- [ ] `thread-service` (threads CRUD, search, title rename, bind).
- [ ] `plan-service` (plans + plan_steps CRUD, accept/decline).
- [ ] `run-service` (runs lifecycle end-to-end + queue drain).
- [ ] `activity-service` (run_activities insert/stream, sub-task nest).
- [ ] `notification-service` + `approval-service` + `key-service` (Vault).
- [ ] `memory-service` (mem0 per-thread + global) — new store scoping.
- [ ] Remove `@aevryn/api` tRPC agent router usage (routes now REST/chat).
      Keep `GET /api/health` if wanted.
- **Verify**: services unit-tested against local Supabase (vitest).

## P4 — Inngest (rebuild functions directory)
- [ ] `thread/run` event + `thread-runner` (streaming run_activities, cost cap
      BEFORE steps, idempotent gate via `runs.status`).
- [ ] `schedule-tick` FIXED: add real trigger (`triggers: [{event...}]` or
      cron) + register along with planner in `/api/inngest` serve.
- [ ] `notification-notifier` registered (webhook/in-app).
- [ ] Remove execution-run legacy + regex decision parsing; prompts centralized
      (`packages/agent/src/prompts.ts` per PROMPTS.md).
- **Verify**: `bun inngest:dev` + `bun dev` — run a sample delegation;
      `run_activities` rows appear; realtime arrives in UI.

## P5 — Chat route + live tools (the heart)
- [ ] `POST /api/chat` route: `streamText` + `ChatTransport`,
      `toUIMessageStream`, `createUIMessageStreamResponse`; session-aware.
- [ ] Tools: `askQuestion`, `showPlan`, `editPlan`, `bindWorkflow`/
      `finalizeAndInject`, `storeMemory`, `searchMemory`, `httpRequest`,
      `delegateAgenticWork` (durable bridge), `listCapabilities`.
- [ ] Tool schemas = zod; `AskUserQuestion` schema shared server/client.
- [ ] Auto-approve switch honored + system "auto-approved" msg.
- [ ] media tools (text live; image/transcription lazy per ENV.md).
- **Verify**: scenarios 1–3 from ARCHITECTURE §I pass end-to-end.

## P6 — Durable queue + attachments
- [ ] `POST /api/queue` drain; queued rows durable; ChatComposer reads DB queue.
- [ ] Image compression (canvas→WebP quality 0.8, ≤2000px) → storage → `files`.
- [ ] ChatMessage attachment props extended (`images/video/audio/pdf`).
- **Verify**: close tab mid-queue + reopen → queue intact + delivers.

## P7 — Frontend wiring (zustand + realtime + widgets)
- [ ] Stores: useAuthStore, useThreadStore, useComposerStore, useSidebarStore,
      useNotificationsStore, useUIStore.
- [ ] `useRealtimeThread(threadId)` subscription → merges broadcast rows.
- [ ] workspace/[threadId] page: real chat load, router push w/o reload,
      composer center→bottom, header real rename + workflow dropdown.
- [ ] AppSidebar: real NAV_SECTIONS, search, notifications chip + mark-read,
      run-all/stop-all, per-item run/stop/rename/share/delete.
- [ ] WorkflowDialog: rename Instructions→Agent + Environment tab + General/
      Share/Plan/Memories wired to real data; delete-confirm works.
- [ ] Settings/Profile dialogs: real user + global-vs-workspace split.
- **Verify**: page-manual QA checklist (scenarios 4–6 in ARCHITECTURE §I).

## P8 — Sub-agents container + markdown (FUTURE phases, stubs designed)
- [ ] `run_activities.parent_id` sub-agent container merge (parallel).
- [ ] Markdown/table renderer (existing Table component; output contract ready).
- **Verify**: sub-agent demo.

## Definition of done (MVP)
- Google-only auth with onboarding.
- Workspaces (Personal) + threads + bound workflows via LLM tools only.
- Live chat streaming + durable Anakin runs streaming to ThinkingSteps.
- Queue durability + auto-approve + notifications chip + per-workspace keys.
- No hardcoded mock data; all mocked UI wired to DB; tRPC removed.

### 8. `runs`  ← a single durable agent pass (an Inngest execution for a thread)
| col | type | notes |
|---|---|---|
| id | text pk `run_` |
| thread_id | text ref threads cascade |
| workflow_id | text ref workflows |
| user_id | uuid |
| trigger | enum(message, schedule, resume, approval) |
| status | enum(pending, running, sleeping, waiting, awaiting_approval, completed, failed, cancelled) |
| prompt_snapshot | jsonb | the prompt/config sent to Inngest |
| cost_usd | numeric(10,6) |
| token_count | bigint |
| finished_at | |
Indexes: (thread_id, created_at desc), (workflow_id, status).
RLS: owner.

### 9. `run_activities`  ← realtime ThinkingSteps feed (Anakin sub-tasks)
| col | type | notes |
|---|---|---|
| id | text pk `act_` |
| run_id | text ref runs cascade |
| parent_id | text ref run_activities null | sub-task nesting |
| type | enum(tool, thinking, task, subtask, system) |
| status | enum(pending, active, complete, failed) |
| step_label | text | e.g. "ResearchAgent", "WebScrapeAgent" |
| title | text | "Reading about.html" |
| description | text |
| detail | jsonb | {url?, sources[], image src?, icon, …} → ThinkingSteps schema |
| started_at / completed_at |
Indexes: (run_id, created_at asc).
RLS: owner.
> Written by Inngest fns, broadcast over Supabase Realtime channel
> `thread:{id}`; client maps row → ThinkingStep / ThinkingStepSource /
> ThinkingStepImage. Mirrors old `event`/`observation` but shaped for UI.

### 10. `approval_requests`
| col | type |
|---|---|
| id | text pk `apv_` |
| run_id | text ref runs on delete cascade |
| workflow_id | text ref workflows |
| thread_id | text ref threads |
| user_id | uuid |
| tool_name | text | which capability needs approval |
| input | jsonb |
| schema | jsonb | AskUserQuestion[] (bind approval) |
| status | enum(pending, approved, denied) |
| auto_approved | bool default false |
| resolved_at |
RLS: owner. Indexes: (status, created_at), (thread_id).

### 11. `notifications`
| col | type |
|---|---|
| id | text pk `not_` |
| user_id | uuid |
| workspace_id | text ref workspaces cascade |
| thread_id | text ref threads null |
| type | enum(system, workflow, run, security, webhook) |
| title, body | text |
| read_at | timestamptz null |
| created_at |
Indexes: (user_id, read_at, created_at desc).
RLS: owner. Read-all marks via update where read_at is null.

### 12. `workspace_api_keys`
| col | type | notes |
|---|---|---|
| id | text pk `key_` |
| workspace_id | text ref workspaces cascade |
| created_by | uuid |
| provider | enum(groq, anakin, mem0, image, speech, transcription, video) |
| key_encrypted | bytea not null | AES-256-GCM or Supabase Vault: `vault.create_secret` |
| model_name | text null | per-provider model override |
| created_at / updated_at |
Unique (workspace_id, provider). RLS: owner only (view masked via RPC).

### 13. `files`  ← uploads (images/pdf) metadata; bytes in Supabase Storage
| col | type |
|---|---|
| id | text pk `fil_` |
| user_id | uuid |
| thread_id | text ref threads null |
| workspace_id | text ref workspaces cascade |
| bucket | text default 'chat-attachments' |
| path | text not null | storage path `{user}/{thread}/{ulid}.ext` |
| mime_type | text |
| size_bytes | bigint |
| compressed | bool default false |
| created_at |
RLS: owner. Storage bucket policy: authenticate (owner by path prefix `{auth.uid()}/`).

### 14. `notification_webhooks` (optional future) — REMOVED from MVP, note only.
External webhooks folded into `notifications` + Inngest `notification/publish`,
existing `webhook-board`/`waitForWebhook` retired.

## Enums (Postgres)
```
role            : owner|admin|member
plan            : free|pro
workflow_status : waiting|planning|running|awaiting_approval|idle|paused|failed|completed
message_role    : user|assistant|system|tool
message_status  : queued|streaming|completed|failed|interrupted
run_status      : pending|running|sleeping|waiting|awaiting_approval|completed|failed|cancelled
activity_status : pending|active|complete|failed
activity_type   : tool|thinking|task|subtask|system
approval_status : pending|approved|denied
api_provider    : groq|anakin|mem0|image|speech|transcription|video
```

## Supabase specifics
- Migrations via `supabase migration new <name>` (imperative workflow).
- **Realtime**: enable on `chat_messages`, `run_activities`,
  `approval_requests`, `notifications` with private channels + JWT auth.
- **Storage bucket**: `chat-attachments` — create server-side w/ service role;
  dedicated policy `(storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text` for
  CUD. Policy for avatar/object keys too.
- **RLS policy list**:
  - everything retrieveable by owner; no cross-workspace leak even if sharing
    added later (member roles ext via `workspace_members`).
  - `workspace_api_keys`: SELECT only to owner via `security definer` RPC
    `get_workspace_key(workspace_id, provider)` that validates membership and
    decrypts server-side (service role decrypt NOT exposed).
- **Oracle triggers**: `on_auth_user_created` → insert `workspaces(Personal)` +
  `user_profiles` row automatically.

## Why this shape (reasoning)
- `threads` + `workflows` split: a chat exists before any plan/bind; binding
  sets `threads.bound_workflow_id`. MVP single-workspace but multi-thread.
- `runs` separate from workflow status: each durable pass is auditable,
  replayable, cancellable; activity tables hang off `run_id`.
- `run_activities` replaces old `event`/`observation`/`agent_state` — shaped
  directly for the ThinkingSteps/ToolStep UI components and realtime push,
  killing the god-table smell.
- `chat_messages` owns history (requirement: no hardcoded mock); queue solved
  by `status=queued` rows — durable across page close/reload.
- Plain user-supplied keys isolated in ONE table (never in env, never client)
  → the "Agent/Environment" dialog writes here.

| `GROQ_API_KEY` / `GROQ_MODEL` | runtime | fallback defaults; per workspace override |

## NEW env (definitive list, final)

```

DATABASE_URL                # postgres connection for drizzle (direct)
DIRECT_URL                  # pooler direct url (non-pooled, for migrations)

ANAKIN_API_KEY

EXECUTION_MAX_SECONDS       # default 900    — ceiling

IMAGE_MODEL                  # default e.g. groq/text2img or provider, optional
SPEECH_MODEL                 # optional
TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL          # optional
VIDEO_MODEL                  # optional (future)
```

> Client (`packages/env/src/web.ts`) must expose only:
> `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`.
> Everything else stays server-only. `SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION` respected.

display.text:
# FEATURES — Beyond the MVP (better capabilities & tools)

Ideas to make the tool stronger. Keep "LLM decides, nothing hardcoded".

## Tool-call improvements

### 1. `httpRequest` (user-bearer arbitrary HTTP)
- Schema: `{method, url, headers?{name,value}[], body?, timeoutMs≤30000,
  auth?:{type:"bearer", token}}`, response `{status, headers, bodyText, bodyJson?}`.
- Safety: SSRF firewall (block private IPs/localhost/metadata), size cap,
  max redirects 3, no follow to non-http. Used when SDK lacks an action.

### 2. Anakin SDK expansion (currently underused — see NOTES/Anakin)
- `sessions.save` → interactive-login flow (createSession → noVNC → user logs in
  → save → authenticate scrapes). Map to `browserSessionSave` capability
  (approval required).
- Screenshots: add `screenshot`/`screenshotFullPage` to scrape formats;
  pipeline downloads PNG server-side (SDK doesn't) → Supabase Storage →
  image part in chat (ThinkingStepImage supports src).
- `forceFresh`, `countries`/`SUPPORTED_COUNTRY_CODES` validation,
  `generateJson`/`outputSchema`, polling knobs.
- Batch scrape (≤10 URLs), inline scrape, `ai-visibility` (fan to 3 engines),
  monitors CRUD, wire catalog/identities/vaults (`wire-run`), Wire file
  downloads (`GET /wire/jobs/:id/download`) — all REST-only, expose via
  capabilities that call raw HTTP (this is where **httpRequest tool** shines:
  LLM can call official REST endpoints not yet wrapped).

### 3. Tool approval replay (existing → keep) + auto-approve system msg
- Keep `replayedToolOutputs` (don't re-run possibly-succeeded writes).
- Auto-approve: workflow.auto_approve → auto-resolve approval + system message
  "auto-approved via settings".

### 4. `listCapabilities` / schema-as-memory
- Resolve adapters/README.md:1: expose capability schemas via GLOBAL memory
  searched by LLM before delegating; keep a static `capabilityCatalog` tool as
  fallback (cheap, in chat). Nothing hardcoded in prompt.

### 5. Media generation (per user request)
- TEXT now. IMAGE/SPEECH/TRANSCRIPTION/VIDEO tool tools defined but only
  activate when user enters a model for that category in workflow Agent/Env tab
  (per `ENV.md`). `generateMedia({kind:"image",prompt,...})` → response image
  uploaded to Storage → message part. ChatMessage attachment props extended to
  `{ files[], images[], video?, audio? }`.

## Architecture extras

### 6. Sub-agent container (FUTURE, "agent assigns sub agents")
- Noted in instructions. Design: durable runner can spawn parallel
  `run_activities` children; each sub-agent returns `{role, findings}` to a
  container activity; main LLM reads container. No DB change — already
  `run_activities.parent_id`.

### 7. Durable queued messages (durability fix)
- User asked for an answer: implement queue rows in DB (`status='queued'`,
  `queue_order`), re-pulled on page load. Auto-fire when current run finishes
  (realtime event). Even plain text survives close — since chat persists.

### 8. Per-workspace keys + Vault
- `workspace_api_keys` (Vault/AES) so each future workspace can BYO keys.
  Env fallback → workspace → thread.

### 9. Realtime notifications (with unread chip)
- Notifications dialog + number chip on thread button (user: "add number chip").
  Realtime broadcast on insert. Mark-all-read on dialog open.

### 10. Image compression pipeline
- Browser canvas: re-encode to WebP, quality ~0.8, max 2000px, keep EXIF?
  no — strip. Then `files` insert + Storage. Same pipeline reused for model
  screenshots.

### 11. Parser-friendly output contract
- All tool outputs structured (`{type, data}`) for future markdown/table
  renderers. Table component exists — return `table` parts when tabular.

## UX polish ideas (fold into UI.md)
- Queue: token-quality slider bugfix (pointer-events) — decouple slider.
- ChatComposer centered→bottom transition on first message.
- Run/Stop button gated on bound workflow; per-item run/stop in sidebar menu.
- Notifications chip; theme toggle; profile dialog; settings=workspace+global
  split (rename workflow-dialog → workspace settings, global vs workspace tabs).

2:

5: and planning inline text). Split by role.
6:

8: packages/agent/src/prompts.ts
9:   system/       — immutable / global behavior
10:   agent/        — chat agent persona + tool policy
11:   planning/     — planning-mode instructions
12:   durable/      — thread-runner instructions (Inngest)
13:   memory/       — memory tool guidance
14:   http/         — http tool policy
15:   subagents/    — (future) container-agent instructions
16: ```
17: 
18: ## 1. `SYSTEM_PERSONA`
19: Intro to aevryn: name, tone (concise, agentic), bounds (chat-only; never
20: pretend to act outside tools), markdown allowed.
21: 
22: ## 2. `SYSTEM_TOOL_POLICY` (replaces TOOL_SELECTION_INSTRUCTIONS)
23: - Never call a tool for greetings/hi/basic Q&A — plain text.
24: - Every Anakin / browser action goes through `delegateAgenticWork` (durable),
25:   never directly in chat.
26: - askQuestion used for ANY uncertainty the answer changes cost of next step.
27: - showPlan AFTER questions; workflowApproval via `finalizeAndInject` only after
28:   plan accepted.
29: - plan editability: LLM may call editPlan at any time post-plan.
30: - Respect auto-approve: if enabled, resolve approval automatically and say
31:   "auto-approved via settings" as system message.
32: 
33: ## 3. `PLANNING_SYSTEM` (works with showPlan/askQuestion flow)
34: "Given the objective, plan scope: ask clarifying questions first when needed.
35: When you're ready, build the plan. Each step must be actionable and
36: factored < 20 lines of description. Order critical steps first."
37: Output: structured via `showPlan(plan)` tool `{steps:[{title,description}]}`.
38: 
39: ## 4. `PLAN_WORKFLOW_APPROVAL` (binding message)
40: "You presented the final plan. Waiting for workflow binding approval
41: (approve / decline / bind / approve-and-run). Do NOT begin actions before
42: approval. If declined, discard plan and ask what changed."
43: 
44: ## 5. `DURABLE_RUNNER_SYSTEM` (thread-runner in Inngest)
45: "You are executing plan step N/total. Only the tools you have may run.
46: Edit plan only via editPlan. Errors: classify and retry with guidance, don't
47: silently stop."
48: 
49: ## 6. `MEMORY_TOOL_GUIDE`
50: "storeMemory: natural-language facts user wants remembered, category semantic.
51: searchMemory: retrieve with query matching intent, scope thread|global."
52: 
53: ## 7. `HTTP_TOOL_POLICY`
54: "httpRequest: ONLY for user-requested integration. Send bearer from the user
55: token field. Do not follow redirects to unexpected hosts. Timeout & size caps."
56: 
57: ## 8. `SUB_AGENT_CONTAINER` (future)
58: "Result JSON: merged into run_activities with type=container. Return markdown
59: ar interesting findings."
60: 
61: ## Usage contract
62: - `buildSystem(workflow, plan, memorySummary)` composes 1..N prompts with glue.
63: - Provider-level vs user-level: nothing user-facing; keys/model come from
64:   workspace_api_keys via key-service BEFORE streamText.
65: - Single source of truth: importing pkg `prompts` anywhere = consistent.
66: 
67: ## Out-of-scope prompts
68: - Retry guidance / recovery hints: move to `prompts.ts` DURABLE section (was
69:   inlined in execution-run.ts): keep same codes (RECOVERY_HINTS) but centralized.

(End of file - total 69 lines)
</content>

  planning/     — planning-mode instructions
  durable/      — thread-runner instructions (Inngest)
  memory/       — memory tool guidance
  http/         — http tool policy
  subagents/    — (future) container-agent instructions
```

## 1. `SYSTEM_PERSONA`
Intro to aevryn: name, tone (concise, agentic), bounds (chat-only; never
pretend to act outside tools), markdown allowed.

## 2. `SYSTEM_TOOL_POLICY` (replaces TOOL_SELECTION_INSTRUCTIONS)
- Never call a tool for greetings/hi/basic Q&A — plain text.
- Every Anakin / browser action goes through `delegateAgenticWork` (durable),
  never directly in chat.
- askQuestion used for ANY uncertainty the answer changes cost of next step.
- showPlan AFTER questions; workflowApproval via `finalizeAndInject` only after
  plan accepted.
- plan editability: LLM may call editPlan at any time post-plan.
- Respect auto-approve: if enabled, resolve approval automatically and say
  "auto-approved via settings" as system message.

## 3. `PLANNING_SYSTEM` (works with showPlan/askQuestion flow)
"Given the objective, plan scope: ask clarifying questions first when needed.
When you're ready, build the plan. Each step must be actionable and
factored < 20 lines of description. Order critical steps first."
Output: structured via `showPlan(plan)` tool `{steps:[{title,description}]}`.

## 4. `PLAN_WORKFLOW_APPROVAL` (binding message)
"You presented the final plan. Waiting for workflow binding approval
(approve / decline / bind / approve-and-run). Do NOT begin actions before
approval. If declined, discard plan and ask what changed."

## 5. `DURABLE_RUNNER_SYSTEM` (thread-runner in Inngest)
"You are executing plan step N/total. Only the tools you have may run.
Edit plan only via editPlan. Errors: classify and retry with guidance, don't
silently stop."

## 6. `MEMORY_TOOL_GUIDE`
"storeMemory: natural-language facts user wants remembered, category semantic.
searchMemory: retrieve with query matching intent, scope thread|global."

## 7. `HTTP_TOOL_POLICY`
"httpRequest: ONLY for user-requested integration. Send bearer from the user
token field. Do not follow redirects to unexpected hosts. Timeout & size caps."

## 8. `SUB_AGENT_CONTAINER` (future)
"Result JSON: merged into run_activities with type=container. Return markdown
ar interesting findings."

## Usage contract
- `buildSystem(workflow, plan, memorySummary)` composes 1..N prompts with glue.
- Provider-level vs user-level: nothing user-facing; keys/model come from
  workspace_api_keys via key-service BEFORE streamText.
- Single source of truth: importing pkg `prompts` anywhere = consistent.

## Out-of-scope prompts
- Retry guidance / recovery hints: move to `prompts.ts` DURABLE section (was
  inlined in execution-run.ts): keep same codes (RECOVERY_HINTS) but centralized.

Now I have all the context. Let me digest the user's answers and plan the updates.

## Answers digested:

### QUESTIONS.md answers:
1. Bind but not run: Yes, once bind, run button appears. User will ask LLM to run OR click run button. If workflow/event running, run button → stop button.
2. 2nd message: user says "if user opens and send 2nd message, that is the plan" — hmm, this is confusing. "if user opens and send 2nd message, that is the plan, LLM should not himself create a plan until LLM decides, user cna agin tell LLM to use this to create a workflow, then LLm can make, not auto ewww." So: LLM should NOT auto-create a plan. Only when the user tells the LLM to create a workflow/plan. So no auto-plan. Plan ONLY via explicit user request.
3. Inngest cron OK.
4. Media: yes, do it. ALSO — ChatComposer and ChatMessage have attachment props for images/video/pdf; if attachment given, turn it into LLM readable format in the schema. So media generation + attachments → LLM-readable. "look into that too."
5. Onboarding questions: use JSON for question set config, user can update it, map the database json to questionflow component. Single and multi both.
6. Auto navigate to onboarding if profile missing. Yes.
7. Queue: once runner finishes, send in order, wait for finish then send another... sequential in order.
8. Edit queued msg: persist updated row, same order.
9. Memory: one place to store all memories of each thread. Do whatever best. → one mem0 per thread basically, consolidated.
10. Global memory: "global memory is the memory that I will give to the program to send to mem0 beforehand, so it will work everywhere, in all workspaces, everywhere" → Global memory = pre-seeded memory that the PROGRAM pushes to mem0 (i.e., a seed bundle provided beforehand), works in all workspaces. NOT per-workspace. So global = program-seeded facts (e.g. adapter schemas, user config facts), vs thread memory = per-thread.
11. HTTP tool: just do what's safe.
12. SDK-compatible name, the new names I made → keep names (finalizeAndInject, bindWorkflow etc.) as I designed. Actually answer says "the new names you made" — keep my new names.
13. Delete account: hard delete incl storage.
14. Pricing: free plan = 5 threads per group, 3 groups per workspace, 1 workspace (multiple workspaces in future/pro). So PLAN limits: 5 threads/group, 3 groups/workspace, multiple workspaces = future. Track cost/token per run yes.
15. Markdown: confirmed but DON'T build now; keep parser-friendly.

### MISSING.md answers:
1. Onboarding Q: JSON-config-driven questions set; single + multi; user updates JSON; DB stores; map DB json → questionflow component.
